title: Projektetage Intro Flow Drag Scale
description: Fix projektetage intro slides 0-6 where dragging text shoots elements out quickly; slide 9 (canvas) works. Root cause likely sectionVisualScale using tall nested reveal stack offsetHeight vs viewport-sized client rect.
summary:
Fixed amplified intro flow drag (double movement application).

Root cause: while dragging, `translate3d` moved the content and a layout effect remeasured ink inside the wrapper, then reapplied `left`/`top` as percentages from the already-translated position — movement was applied twice (feels like hundreds of px from a few px).

Fix:
- Do not apply ink percentage frame (`contentInkStyle`) while `flowPixelOffset` is active; only `translate3d`.
- Freeze ink remeasurement during `gesturing` so drag does not retrigger layout feedback.

Intro drag test asserts ~80px translate for 80px pointer travel and empty content left/top during drag.
